label: Insulin signalling (global)
description: Scales insulin action at all sites simultaneously.

label: Glucagon signalling (hepatic HGP)
description: Scales the glucagon signal driving hepatic glucose production.

label: Insulin signalling inhibition
description: Scales insulin action downward; u=1 is complete insulin resistance.

label: Glucagon signalling inhibition
description: u=1 abolishes glucagon stimulation of HGP.

label: Beta-cell secretion impairment
description: u=1 abolishes endogenous insulin secretion (T1DM limit).

label: Insulin signalling (peripheral uptake)
description: Scales the insulin signal driving peripheral glucose uptake (MIPGU).

label: Insulin signalling (hepatic: HGP + HGU)
description: Scales insulin action on hepatic glucose production and uptake.
